name: Haven
headline: Alt.binaries for DataDAOs — build the sovereign media protocol.
description: Haven is an L7 sovereign media protocol over Arkiv OP L3 (reth precompile 0x44…0044, ephemeral entities with btl/regex search) + ICP VetKD (haven-aol dciac-…qlzuq, token-gated VetKD per cid/epoch) + any EVM gate + Filecoin Onchain Cloud (IPFS CID only in Arkiv, three retrieval paths). Five decoupled surfaces, no private backend (Datastores:0). This project covers the 5-surface stack: arkiv entity shape (Ident32/Mime128), haven-aol (VetKD gating for DAOs/DataDAOs/agent swarms), haven-dapp/haven-cli/haven-mobile/foc-local-first-android — private-tracker replacement for token-gated communities.

steward.displayName: Human Activity Valuation and Exploration Network

repositories.description: Living architecture docs for Haven — 5 decoupled surfaces, Arkiv L3 entity shape (0x44…0044), no shared DB. Source of truth for Web3 paradigm, ENTITY_SHAPE, MEDIA_CONTENT_SPEC.
Always Online (AOL), an ICP-native protocol for conditional, token-gated access using VetKD keys. AOL enables smart access patterns across web3—DAOs, DataDAOs, agent swarms, and shared resources.
Haven dapp — TypeScript/Next.js 15 Web3 frontend for Arkiv entity discovery (arkiv_query) + VetKD decrypt + Filecoin playback.
Reclaiming the Internet for the User. — Haven CLI media pipeline (arkiv_sync.py), encryption, archival over Arkiv + VetKD + Filecoin.
Haven mobile — Kotlin (Compose/Media3/Room) Android offline-first viewer with foc-cache, Filecoin multi-path retrieval.

Kotlin/Android library for local-first retrieval of Filecoin Onchain Cloud content. Implements three retrieval paths (direct SP /piece, FilBeam CDN, IPFS) with multi-provider hedged race, disk cache with LRU eviction and TTL.
Incubator for experimental Haven clients — audio, images, docs, datasets, models, 3D, archives. SLOP testbed: merged PRs count under haven; graduates promote to standalone repos/projects.
